title: Accounts Schedule for Customer-Pay Repairs: Payment Methods, Financing, Fleet Terms, Warranty Issued and Goodwill Authority
content:
Accounts-side schedule for Customer-Pay Repairs. By service tier it lists the payment methods accepted, whether the balance may be financed and from what balance, the fleet payment terms, the workmanship warranty issued on delivery, and the most the desk may credit as goodwill on one repair order.

## Schedule

| Service tier | Payment methods accepted | Financing available | Smallest balance that may be financed (USD) | Fleet payment terms (calendar days after delivery) | Workmanship warranty issued on delivery | Goodwill credit authority per repair order (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paintless Dent Repair Service | card, cash | No | 0.00 (not applicable) | 30 | Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty | 25.00 |
| Cosmetic Touch-Up Service | card, cash | No | 0.00 (not applicable) | 30 | Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty | 25.00 |
| Bumper Refinish Service | card, ACH, cash, check, financing | Yes | 500.00 | 30 | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | 40.00 |
| Panel Repair Service | card, ACH, cash, check, financing | Yes | 500.00 | 30 | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | 60.00 |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | card, ACH, cash, check, financing | Yes | 500.00 | 30 | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | 100.00 |
| Complete Refinish Service | card, ACH, cash, check, financing | Yes | 500.00 | 30 | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | 150.00 |

## Defined terms

- **Payment methods accepted**: Payment methods accepted (list).
- **Financing available**: Whether the balance may be financed through the network's partner (boolean).
- **Smallest financed balance**: Smallest balance that may be financed (USD; 0.00 means not applicable).
- **Fleet payment terms**: Calendar days after delivery within which a fleet account pays its invoice (integer).
- **Warranty issued**: Official name of the workmanship warranty issued on delivery.
- **Goodwill credit authority**: Most the desk may credit as goodwill on one repair order (USD).

## Notes

- The two entry tiers accept card and cash only and offer no financing; the four higher tiers accept card, ACH, cash, check and financing, with financing from a balance of 500.00.
- Fleet accounts have 30 calendar days after delivery in every tier.
- The Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty is issued by the two entry tiers; the Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty by the four higher tiers.
- Hypothetical balances on a Bumper Refinish Service order: 500.00 is at the smallest financed balance; 499.99 is below it.
